map.最小方差法 h* = ρ·σS/σF；R²=ρ² 衡量对冲效果。建议手数 = 现: Minimum-variance method: h* = ρ · σS / σF; R² = ρ² measures effectiveness. Suggested contracts = spot exposure × h* / value per contract, then rounded.

map.最优对冲比例 h* = ρ × (σS ÷ σF)（ρ 现货期货相关系数）: Optimal hedge ratio h* = ρ × (σS ÷ σF) (ρ is the spot–futures correlation)
map.对冲效果 R² = ρ²；未被对冲风险 = (1 − ρ²) × 100%: Hedge effectiveness R² = ρ²; unhedged risk = (1 − ρ²) × 100%
map.效果评级：R² > 90% 优秀｜>70% 良好｜>50% 一般｜其他 较差: Effectiveness rating: R² > 90% excellent | >70% good | >50% fair | otherwise poor
map.期货合约价值 = 期货价格 × 合约乘数: Futures contract value = futures price × contract multiplier
map.理论对冲合约数 = 现货总价值 × h* ÷ 合约价值: Theoretical hedge contracts = total spot value × h* ÷ contract value
map.对冲覆盖比例 = 手数 × 合约价值 ÷ 现货总价值 × 100%: Hedge coverage = contracts × contract value ÷ total spot value × 100%
map.方向：卖出套保（持现货怕跌）或买入套保（未来要买怕涨）: Direction: short hedge (holding spot, fearing a fall) or long hedge (buying later, fearing a rise)

map.最小方差法 h* = ρ·σS/σF；R²=ρ² 是正确方向下的理论风险降低上限: Minimum-variance h* = rho·sigmaS/sigmaF; R²=rho² is the theoretical risk-reduction ceiling when traded in the correct direction. h*<0 means the selected direction is opposite to the minimum-variance direction, so executable lots are 0 and the futures position should be reversed; integer-lot actual coverage is shown separately, not confused with the theoretical coverage.
map.正相关示例：σS=3%、σF=3.5%、ρ=0.85 → h*=0.7286，R: Positive-correlation example: sigmaS=3%, sigmaF=3.5%, rho=0.85 gives h*=0.7286 and R²=72.25%; with 1,000,000 spot exposure and a contract value of 3800×300=1,140,000 per lot, one lot covers 114.0% actually versus 72.86% theoretical. Negative example: rho=−0.85 gives h*=−0.7286, so the selected direction is not executable (0 lots) and the position must be reversed. Pure calculation demo, not investment advice.
map.h* 为负怎么办？: What should I do if h* is negative?
map.负号说明所选期货方向与最小方差方向相反：按原方向建仓会放大风险，应把多空方向反过: The negative sign means the selected futures direction is opposite to the minimum-variance direction: trading it would increase risk, so reverse the long/short direction. The tool therefore sets executable lots to 0 and shows the reverse lots separately.
